title: Tiny, cute tent
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='38' ry='5' fill='#2a4a3a' opacity='0.6'/>
  
  <!-- Tent body - main triangle shape -->
  <polygon points='50,18 12,85 88,85' fill='#3d8b5e'/>
  
  <!-- Tent right side darker panel -->
  <polygon points='50,18 88,85 50,85' fill='#2d7048'/>
  
  <!-- Tent left side lighter highlight -->
  <polygon points='50,18 12,85 50,85' fill='#4da86e'/>
  
  <!-- Tent left edge highlight -->
  <line x1='50' y1='18' x2='12' y2='85' stroke='#6dd48f' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  
  <!-- Tent right edge highlight -->
  <line x1='50' y1='18' x2='88' y2='85' stroke='#3d8b5e' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  
  <!-- Tent entrance - dark opening -->
  <polygon points='50,35 34,85 66,85' fill='#1a3a2a'/>
  
  <!-- Tent entrance inner glow (lit by Doot) -->
  <polygon points='50,42 38,82 62,82' fill='#24503a'/>
  
  <!-- Tent entrance flap tied back left -->
  <polygon points='50,35 34,85 30,85 46,35' fill='#4da86e'/>
  
  <!-- Tent entrance flap tied back right -->
  <polygon points='50,35 66,85 70,85 54,35' fill='#3d8b5e'/>
  
  <!-- Ridge line on tent -->
  <line x1='50' y1='18' x2='50' y2='35' stroke='#6dd48f' stroke-width='2'/>
  
  <!-- Tent pole top -->
  <rect x='48.5' y='12' width='3' height='8' rx='1' fill='#c8a84e'/>
  
  <!-- Small flag on top -->
  <polygon points='51,12 64,16 51,20' fill='#e8d44e'/>
  
  <!-- Little peg stakes at bottom -->
  <rect x='10' y='83' width='6' height='3' rx='1' fill='#9e8a3a'/>
  <rect x='84' y='83' width='6' height='3' rx='1' fill='#9e8a3a'/>
  
  <!-- Tiny stars -->
  <circle cx='20' cy='15' r='1' fill='#a8f0d4'/>
  <circle cx='80' cy='22' r='1' fill='#a8f0d4'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='10' r='0.8' fill='#a8f0d4'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='12' r='0.8' fill='#a8f0d4'/>
</svg>
